entities.summary: The Kremlin Armoury is one of the oldest museums in Moscow. It is located in the Moscow Kremlin, and is a part of the Moscow Kremlin Museum. Kremlin Armoury is a museum in Europe, established in 1806. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
